name: @epoch/action-gateway
description: Epoch Action Gateway service (W022) — the EXECUTION AUTHORITY (architecture lock rule 3: actions execute only through the Action Gateway): tenant-scoped intake over @epoch/action-policy (typed policy decisions with full W004 provenance, append-only hash-chained records), the W009 authorization gate (unauthenticated/unauthorized intake is typed authorization-rejected BEFORE policy evaluation), the human-approval flow (quorum, deadlines, delegation bounds, supersession — approval authorizes exactly the referenced decision + proposal revision), execution dispatch behind the ActionExecutionPort adapter seam (the gateway records record-shaped outcomes ONLY — typed success/failure records with evidence references; it never implements side effects), the action:* event vocabulary over the W010 event shapes (one action = one stream, digests mirror computeEventDigest, admitted by the real sealEvent — devDep parity), and health/snapshot as typed data. In-memory reference behavior: NO persistence, NO network, NO real side effects; core logic stays pure (zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied).
